teaser: Feisty Duck, briefed: an anchor for TLS, PKI and cryptography, what it shares with our newsrooms, and how we could integrate.
core_idea: Feisty Duck's expert, continuously published TLS, PKI and cryptography content, including a news feed with LLM summaries, a newsletter, a free guide and a 174-event history, is a natural anchor for our crypto claims; it shares our continuous publishing and curation, and integration can start by linking and checking, while capturing its content in a vault waits for its permission.

figures.caption: Feisty Duck on 25 October 2026: Feisty Duck News, the live front page of cryptography and security news; the Cryptography & Security Newsletter, with issues to #141, "Get Ready for Seven-Day Certificates"; the SSL/TLS and PKI History, starting with SSL v2 in 1994; and the free Bulletproof TLS Guide, last updated on 16 June 2026.

Feisty Duck, in numbers: the 100 items in the news feed between 1 September and 25 October 2026, by category, led by post-quantum cryptography (24), PKI (21), cryptography (18) and security (17); and the 174 events in the SSL/TLS and PKI history, by decade, 109 of them in the 2010s, scored 115 positive and 56 negative.

How Feisty Duck and our newsrooms could fit together: Feisty Duck curates and explains; we link our crypto, TLS and PKI claims to its guide, book and newsletter as an anchor, now; we could run a crypto and TLS wire that follows the same public sources and credits Feisty Duck News; we could add provenance to the LLM summaries of items we cite; and, with permission, keep the history as a graph and capture pages in a vault.
